text:
Rafael: Quick policy check — I booked an Airbnb for a 5-night work trip. Host sent one invoice for the full stay and I paid with my personal card because corporate card wouldn't accept the host. Two nights were personal (extended weekend). Can I expense the business nights?
Ava (People Ops): Yes — same principle as hotels. We need documentation showing the business nights. Preferred: ask the host for a split invoice. If host won't split, upload the single invoice + your calendar/meeting invite and a short calculation showing the business portion.
Rafael: The host says they can't issue VAT invoices (they're individual hosts). Does that block reimbursement?
Sam (Finance): Not necessarily. For VAT reclaim it matters, but reimbursement to the employee is fine without a VAT invoice. Upload the Airbnb receipt (itemized), proof of payment, and show which nights were business. Finance will classify VAT as non-reclaimable if supplier is not VAT-registered.
Lina: Also include the Airbnb reservation page PDF — it often shows nightly rates which helps validate your calc.
Rafael: What about using my loyalty points to cover the personal nights and the host charged me nothing for those nights?
Ava (People Ops): If loyalty points reduced your out-of-pocket cost for personal nights, you still should only expense the actual amount you paid that pertains to business. Note in the expense submission how points were applied. If points covered some business nights, we need an equivalent cash value statement from the portal to compute company liability.
Rafael: I had to pay a small cleaning fee that the host applied to the whole stay. Can I split that pro rata?
Sam (Finance): Yes, split proportional to nights. Show your calculation (e.g., cleaning 50.00 USD / 5 nights * 3 business nights = 30.00 USD). Attach the invoice showing the fee.
Rafael: My card statement shows a single converted USD charge; receipt is in GBP. Enter GBP amount?
Sam (Finance): Enter original currency (GBP) and amount. Attach the card statement showing the USD charge. We convert per policy.
ExpenseBot: Reminder: do not submit personal charges. Separate line items for personal vs business. :white_check_mark:
Rafael: Any guidance if Airbnb sends a payout to host but the platform fees are confusing?
Ava (People Ops): Upload everything: reservation confirmation, host invoice, platform fee breakdown. If unclear, flag the submission and Finance will reach out.
Rafael: Thanks — I'll DM the receipts if anything looks off.
Ava (People Ops): Happy to review before you submit. People Ops > Travel > Airbnb & alternative lodging has the step-by-step.
